text_block_list.name: Hotel Staff
text_block_list.text:
Please wait just a little longer
until we are ready to guide you.

Today, on Christmas Day, I was invited
to a major event together with Daiichi Ruby.
An offer was made to throw a party celebrating her achievements up to today, and as her trainer, I was to attend as a guest of honor.

With the "Splendid Clan" as the guests of honor, many political and business luminaries are in attendance.
I must be extremely careful with my conduct...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Stay focused, don't let your guard down.
It's time.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting, everyone.
Please welcome them with a round of applause.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Daiichi Ruby
and her Trainer.
(Clap clap clap clap...)

Entering the venue, many people were applauding.
Just glancing around, you could see political and business titans, star athletes, leading scholars... a truly glittering lineup.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much
for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "I am deeply honored that so many people have shown an interest."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The fact that I was able to achieve today's success
is entirely due to the gracious support of you all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will push forward and strive
to elevate the renown of my family even further.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to look forward to the brilliance
of the "Illustrious Clan" from here on as well.
choice_data_list: I humbly look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

The party started, and after finishing my initial rounds of greetings,
I was finally able to settle down.
Just as I was catching my breath...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I'll step away for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please attend to the guests of honor.
If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I believe that is unnecessary. Simply conduct yourself as you deem appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Guest A
text_block_list.text: —I see, so that's what happened behind the scenes of that Mile CS...

text_block_list.name: Newspaper Company Chairman
text_block_list.text: I hear our company's employees have also been honored with the opportunity to assist.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, it turned out to be a wonderful race.

text_block_list.text:
When Daiichi Ruby stepped away and left me alone,
various people immediately approached to talk to me.
I handled their myriad questions with a resolute attitude.

text_block_list.name: Guest B
text_block_list.text:
"However... wasn't becoming the trainer
for the 'Illustrious Clan'
an extraordinary amount of pressure?"
We certainly faced our share of hardships. But... looking back, my journey with her has given me so much—
choice_data_list: I'm grateful for everything that happened

text_block_list.text:
The party ended without a hitch,
and on the way back to the academy
in the car provided by the hosts—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Good work out there.
choice_data_list: Thank you for your hard work...

text_block_list.text: Perhaps the tension finally broke—the moment I sank into the plush chair, a wave of drowsiness washed over me...
choice_data_list: (I need to be careful not to yawn...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Please don't worry about it and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: You've been on high alert for so long; you must be exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Though the travel time is brief,
I hope it allows you to soothe your fatigue, even if just a little.
She, too, had been tense for a long time. Yet even with just the two of us in the car, she still sat with her back straight.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about me.
I'm used to it.
choice_data_list: In that case, I'm staying up too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I appreciate the thought.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, whether you rest or not, Trainer,
is of no concern to me."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There is no need to bind yourself with pointless obligations.
choice_data_list: Still, that's what I want to do.

text_block_list.text: This action might be completely meaningless. Even so, I want to be ready to move immediately. So that I can be of help to her at any timeâ
choice_data_list: Always being prepared is what makes us magnificent—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Right after saying that.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Your conduct today was magnificent.

I finally woke up by the time we reached the academy,
and while I felt a bit embarrassed...
the Christmas night sky was breathtaking.
This action might be completely meaningless. Even so, I want to be ready to move immediately. So that I can be of help to her at any timeâ
choice_data_list: Always being prepared is what I do as your Trainer.
Always being prepared is what I do as your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, please do as you like.

Even after shifting in my seat, I'm still sleepy...
Trying to concentrate only makes the drowsiness heavier.

Faced with irresistible drowsiness,
consciousness slowly begins to slip away.
choice_data_list: (No good, I have to snap out of it—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Here, have some coffee.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since there was equipment inside the vehicle,
I brewed it for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: They probably just want to embody their own ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: If that is so—then see it through to the end.

The coffee Daiichi Ruby brewed was exceptionally rich...
On that freezing Christmas night,
it felt like receiving a warm present.
